Read and validate an lgr configuration

Source: R/config.R
read_config.Rd

Parses, interpolates and validates a declarative lgr configuration without applying it to any logger. Useful for checking a config file (e.g. in CI) or for programmatically inspecting a config before applying it. See config for the format.

Usage

read_config(x, allow_code = FALSE)

validate_config(x, allow_code = FALSE)

Arguments

x

a character scalar (a file path, or a YAML/JSON string), or a list following the config format described in config.

allow_code

TRUE or FALSE. Whether to permit the inline code: form for exception_handler and filter entries, which evaluates config-supplied R source. Defaults to FALSE (safe mode).

Value

an object of class lgr_config (a validated, interpolated nested list), invisibly usable with Logger$config().

validate_config() returns TRUE (invisibly) if x is valid, and throws an informative error otherwise.

Examples

cfg <- read_config(list(loggers = list(root = list(threshold = "warn"))))
validate_config(list(loggers = list(root = list(threshold = "warn"))))
